topics.real_world_use: Science museums build pendulum wave sculptures as crowd-pleasing physics exhibits.

topics.name: Magnetic Levitation Model
topics.concept: Stable magnetic levitation balances the upward magnetic force against gravity, with active feedback adjusting the coil current as the gap changes. The model finds equilibrium gaps and tests how disturbances settle or grow.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG samples coil currents and gaps, solves the force balance, and logs stability margins.
topics.real_world_use: Maglev train and magnetic bearing engineers verify lift and stability margins with levitation models.

topics.name: Electrostatic Precipitator Model
topics.concept: An electrostatic precipitator charges dust particles with a corona discharge and pulls them to collector plates with a strong electric field. Collection efficiency rises with plate area and falls with gas velocity, following the Deutsch Anderson relation.

key_params.plate_area: total collector area in square meters
key_params.gas_flow_rate: gas volume flow in cubic meters per second

topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG samples precipitator geometries and particle sizes, computes drift velocities and efficiencies, and logs performance.
topics.real_world_use: Power plants clean flue gas with electrostatic precipitators sized from collection models.

topics.name: Geiger Counter Simulator
topics.concept: A Geiger counter clicks each time ionizing radiation triggers an avalanche in its gas tube, with counts arriving as a Poisson process. After each click the tube goes briefly dead, so high rates need dead-time correction to recover the true activity.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG generates Poisson event streams, applies dead-time losses, and exports the click timestamps.
topics.real_world_use: Radiation safety teams survey workplaces and check contamination with Geiger counters.

topics.name: Cloud Chamber Track Analyzer
topics.concept: Charged particles leave trails of droplets in a supersaturated cloud chamber, and the curvature of each track in a magnetic field reveals the particle's momentum. The analyzer fits circles to synthetic tracks and estimates momentum from the radius.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG generates curved tracks with random momenta, adds droplet noise, and exports the point sets for circle fitting.
topics.real_world_use: Particle physics outreach labs let students measure cosmic ray momenta from real chamber photos.

topics.name: Cyclotron Resonance Calculator
topics.concept: In a cyclotron, charged particles spiral outward in step with an alternating electric field because their orbital frequency stays constant in a uniform magnetic field. The calculator finds the resonant frequency and the maximum energy before relativity detunes the orbit.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG samples magnet strengths and particle species, computes cyclotron frequencies, and logs the energy limits.
topics.real_world_use: Medical cyclotron facilities tune RF systems to the resonance when producing PET isotopes.

topics.name: Muon Lifetime Relativity Lab
topics.concept: Muons created in the upper atmosphere live only two microseconds, yet reach the ground because time dilation stretches their lifetime at near-light speeds. Counting muon decays at different altitudes and fitting the survival curve tests special relativity directly.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG simulates muon decays along flight paths with time dilation, then exports the altitude-dependent count rates.
topics.real_world_use: Undergraduate labs and cosmic ray observatories verify relativity with muon flux measurements.

topics.name: Gravitational Lensing Demo
topics.concept: A massive galaxy bends the light of objects behind it, magnifying and sometimes splitting their images into arcs or rings. The Einstein radius sets the scale of the effect from the lens mass and the geometry of the alignment.

key_params.lens_distance: distance to the lens in megaparsecs

topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG places lenses and sources with random alignments, computes image positions and magnifications, and exports the lensing map.
topics.real_world_use: Astrophysicists weigh galaxy clusters by modeling the arcs they lens.

topics.name: Black Hole Shadow Model
topics.concept: A black hole casts a dark shadow about five times its event horizon because photon orbits near the hole either escape or fall in. The model ray-traces light paths in curved spacetime to render the shadow and the bright photon ring.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG samples black hole masses and spins, integrates photon geodesics, and logs the shadow diameter.
topics.real_world_use: The Event Horizon Telescope collaboration models shadows to interpret images of M87 and Sagittarius A.

topics.name: Cosmic Ray Flux Monitor
topics.concept: Cosmic rays rain down constantly, and their flux rises and falls with the solar cycle as the solar wind shields Earth. The monitor counts synthetic detector hits, corrects for pressure and temperature, and tracks the flux trend.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG generates Poisson hit streams modulated by solar activity, applies atmospheric corrections, and logs daily flux.
topics.real_world_use: Neutron monitor stations worldwide track cosmic ray flux for space weather forecasting.

topics.name: Tides Harmonic Analyzer
topics.concept: Ocean tides are the sum of many sinusoidal constituents driven by the Moon and Sun, each with its own period and amplitude. Fitting tide gauge records to these harmonics lets the analyzer predict future high and low waters.

key_params.constituent_count: number of tidal harmonics to fit

topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG synthesizes tide records from known constituents with noise, then exports the series for harmonic fitting.
topics.real_world_use: Port authorities publish tide tables from harmonic analyses of local gauge data.

topics.name: Satellite Ground Track Plotter
topics.concept: A satellite's ground track is the path its orbit traces over the rotating Earth, shifting westward each revolution. Given orbital elements, the plotter predicts passes over ground stations and their timing.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG samples orbits and stations, propagates the orbit with Earth rotation, and logs pass start and end times.
topics.real_world_use: Amateur radio operators and Earth-observation teams schedule contacts and imaging passes from ground-track predictions.

topics.name: Spring Pendulum Chaos
topics.concept: A mass bouncing on a spring while swinging like a pendulum couples its up-down and side-to-side motions through the spring tension. At certain energies the exchange between bouncing and swinging becomes chaotic, with no repeating pattern.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG sets initial conditions at random energies, integrates the coupled equations, and logs the trajectory and energy exchange.
topics.real_world_use: Nonlinear dynamics courses use the spring pendulum as a tabletop example of Hamiltonian chaos.

topics.name: Magnetic Dipole Torque Lab
topics.concept: A compass needle or current loop in a magnetic field feels a torque that twists it toward alignment, proportional to the sine of the angle between the dipole and the field. The lab measures oscillation frequencies of the dipole to extract its magnetic moment.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG varies moments and fields, simulates the torsional oscillation with damping noise, and logs the period.
topics.real_world_use: Magnetometer manufacturers calibrate compass and torque sensors against known dipole moments.

topics.name: Electric Motor Design Studio
topics.concept: A DC motor converts current into torque through the Lorentz force on its windings, with speed limited by the back EMF it generates as it spins. The studio trades winding turns, magnet strength, and voltage to hit a target torque and speed.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG samples motor designs, computes torque-speed curves from the electromechanical equations, and logs the performance envelope.
topics.real_world_use: Small-motor manufacturers iterate winding and magnet choices with design studios before prototyping.
